creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-02 once in a full gate on the Mac mini at load 17 to 31 (other agents' builds), on branch reopen-closed-pane, and it passed run alone straight after. It failed at crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon/arranging.rs:420: the first event in the rename's answer was a PaneChanged for "a" with no label, `(None, "first working build")`, where the test expects the rename's own `(Some("🤖 A"), "first working build")`.

So the answer carried another PaneChanged for the same pane ahead of the rename's, likely one the title change or a state change queued just before the rename landed. The test reads `asked.events[0]` and assumes it is the rename's. Have it look for the PaneChanged that carries the label, or wait until the title's change has been announced before renaming.
title: 🎲 A pane's rename answer can lead with another PaneChanged under load
